title: discern: semantic ifs over images from vision-language logits
description: Ask a vision model a question and read the answer from its answer-token logits in one forward pass, with no decoding and nothing trained. Includes the evaluation on MMBench en/dev (4,329 items) and POPE (9,000 items) behind the paper, and the finding that the reported probability and the logit gap are one signal that only survives float32 in nats.
